name: SIM900A GSM / GPRS
summary: 2G GSM/GPRS modem controlled with AT commands.
caution: Requires a dedicated burst-current-rated supply, compatible SIM/antenna and confirmed local 2G service; verify UART logic levels.

name: SIM800L GSM
summary: Common 2G GSM modem controlled through AT commands.
caution: Do not assume 5V supply or MCU GPIO power. Carrier 2G coverage and exact breakout requirements must be checked.

name: SIM7600 4G LTE
summary: Cellular LTE modem family; supported bands and board connections vary by region and variant.
caution: Check exact SIM7600 variant, cellular bands, antenna and dedicated supply; not a drop-in SIM900 replacement.

name: NEO-6M GPS
summary: Receives GPS navigation data, commonly via NMEA serial messages.
caution: NEO-6 is an older module family. Breakout supply levels differ from bare IC ratings; GPS fix needs an antenna and satellite visibility.

name: NEO-M8N GNSS
summary: Multi-constellation GNSS receiver family used in navigation applications.
caution: Verify exact module interface, firmware, antenna and board supply before designing connections.

name: HC-05 Bluetooth
summary: Bluetooth Classic serial transceiver commonly controlled through UART.
caution: Confirm 3.3V UART levels on the specific board; do not confuse Bluetooth Classic with BLE.

name: nRF24L01 2.4 GHz RF
summary: Common 2.4 GHz packet-radio transceiver module.
caution: Check its 3.3V supply and decoupling; never connect 5V logic to a non-tolerant SPI module.

name: SX1278 / RA-02 LoRa
summary: LoRa radio transceiver used for long-range low-data-rate communication.
caution: Use region-appropriate permitted frequencies, a suitable antenna and compatible 3.3V power/logic.

name: MFRC522 RFID reader
summary: 13.56 MHz RFID reader module used for reading supported tags.
caution: Check radio protocol, tags, power and SPI logic; RFID IDs alone are not secure authentication.

name: PN532 NFC / RFID
summary: NFC reader/controller module supporting multiple communication interfaces.
caution: Select and verify the breakout's hardware interface, supply and available libraries.

name: BME280 environment sensor
summary: Sensor family for temperature, humidity and pressure measurements.
caution: BME280 and BMP280 are not identical; verify breakout marking, I2C address and voltage levels.

name: BMP280 pressure sensor
summary: Sensor family for pressure and temperature measurements.
caution: Do not expect humidity readings; verify actual module variant and breakout voltage regulator.

name: MPU-6050 IMU
summary: Motion sensor with acceleration and gyroscope measurements.
caution: Confirm address selection, voltage tolerance and orientation calibration before use.

name: DS18B20 temperature
summary: Digital temperature sensor used on a one-wire data bus.
caution: Verify sensor authenticity, wiring mode, pull-up and supply voltage; water resistance depends on probe assembly.

name: MAX30102 optical pulse sensor
summary: Optical heart-rate sensing component sometimes included in hobby breakout modules.
caution: Educational estimates are not medical measurements; verify board voltage, optical layout and signal conditioning.

name: ADS1115 16-bit ADC
summary: External analog-to-digital converter useful for low-voltage measurements.
caution: Inputs must remain within the converter's supply and absolute ratings; never measure high voltage directly.

name: INA219 power monitor
summary: Shunt-based voltage/current monitor family for DC circuits.
caution: Check common-mode voltage, shunt selection, ground and current direction before designing power systems.

name: INA226 voltage/current monitor
summary: Digital current/voltage/power monitor for shunt-based DC measurement.
caution: Verify bus voltage, common-mode range, shunt resistor and calibration; not directly suitable for mains.

name: SSD1306 OLED 128x64
summary: Monochrome OLED controller often used with Arduino graphics libraries.
caution: I2C address, driver variant, pull-ups and breakout voltage capabilities must be verified.

name: LCD1602 I2C display
summary: Character LCD using an I2C expander backpack.
caution: The backpack's address, chip and LCD voltage vary; confirm PCF8574 variant and pull-up levels.

name: MCP2515 CAN controller
summary: Standalone CAN controller typically connected to an external CAN transceiver.
caution: CAN electrical bus requires an appropriate transceiver and termination; controller alone is insufficient.

name: MAX485 RS-485
summary: Differential serial transceiver for half-duplex RS-485 networks.
caution: Check bus termination, biasing, direction control, grounding and device variant logic levels.

name: HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance
summary: Time-of-flight ultrasonic distance module with trigger and echo signals.
caution: Many 5V versions output a 5V echo; use level shifting when connecting to 3.3V GPIO.

name: DHT22 / AM2302
summary: Low-cost temperature/humidity sensor family with a dedicated digital protocol.
caution: DHT11 and DHT22 have different performance; confirm the module supply and data pull-up.

name: MQ-series gas sensors
summary: Heated semiconductor gas sensors used for approximate educational indications.
caution: Not calibrated life-safety alarms. Sensor heater requires power; outputs, warm-up and calibration differ by MQ type.

name: DS3231 RTC
summary: Battery-backed I2C real-time clock often used for logging and scheduled control.
caution: Confirm backup-cell chemistry, I2C address and board voltage/pull-up behavior.

name: MicroSD SPI module
summary: Removable microSD storage for logging sensor measurements.
caution: Check 3.3V card interface, module level shifting, CS pin and filesystem robustness.

name: L298N dual H-bridge driver
summary: Dual H-bridge for brushed DC motors or bipolar steppers.
caution: Motor power, thermal dissipation, back-EMF and separate MCU supply require engineering review.

name: Hobby servo motor
summary: Position or continuous-rotation hobby servos depending on the exact model.
caution: Do not assume continuous-rotation servos are position-controllable; use a separate appropriately sized supply.

name: Relay module 5V
summary: Electromechanical relay breakouts for electrically isolated switching.
caution: Verify input activation polarity, coil current, isolation and contact ratings. Avoid mains projects in Studio.
